system.description:
You understand how the human (and, to a lesser extent, Cainite) body functions, able to speed a mortal's healing or use that knowledge to inflict injury. Many Cainites learn just enough to know where to bite or how to punish their ghouls.

Medicine can speed a mortal's healing by one category (a Wounded mortal heals as if Bruised), and supports research and lab work with a Mental Challenge. The Storyteller may require a specialty such as Pharmaceuticals, Internal Medicine or General Practice.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
